answer: Treat identity like scarce land, not a free meadow. Make each agent post a refundable stake bond to join; a sybil swarm must then fund thousands of separate deposits, so faking a crowd costs real capital. Reputation climbs toward a summit slowly through verified honest work, and misbehavior slashes the bond. No agent is a cheap island: peers must vouch and co-sign, binding each newcomer to accountable, costly history.
